name: full_reconciles
note: AccountFullReconcile.create and account.move.line.full_reconcile_id (addons/account/models/account_full_reconcile.py:14-45): every full reconcile with its audit users; read-only replay over the whole population
source_sql: SELECT id, create_uid, write_uid FROM account_full_reconcile ORDER BY id

name: full_reconciles_per_user
note: reconciliation activity per user (reconciliation report grouping): full reconciles counted by create_uid
source_sql: SELECT create_uid, count(*) AS reconciles FROM account_full_reconcile GROUP BY create_uid ORDER BY create_uid
